# Third-party code

This folder holds MATLAB code written by other people. `setup.m` at the
repository root adds `third_party/matlab/` to the MATLAB path.

The author, copyright, licence and reference lines in these files are kept
exactly as they were. Only the comments in the places listed under "Local
changes" below have been changed.

File Exchange code is distributed under the BSD licence, which requires the
licence text to stay with the code. Every component has its licence or attribution file next to the code.

## Notes

- **`ReadSphModes.m` and `importfile_sph.m`** are also by D.B. Davidson (`importfile_sph.m` was
  generated by MATLAB's import tool and annotated by him). `ReadSphModes_freqs.m` calls
  `importfile_sph.m`, so the FEKO `.sph` (Q-coefficient) workflows depend on this folder.
- **`ReadSphModes_freqs.m`** says: "DB Davidson, Feb 2024 (original
  single-frequency version). Extended for multi-frequency support
  in this project."
- **`tests/TestLegendreDerivative.m`** has no author header. It is most
  likely the unit-test class of Oldenhuis' `legendre_derivative` package
  (version 2.0.0 "added unit tests"); it is covered by the same licence,
  `matlab/legendre_derivative/License.txt`. One typo was fixed
  (`norms = {'norm'}`).

## Local changes

- **`SHRotate.m`.** The input rotation matrix is first projected onto the
  nearest orthogonal matrix (`normalize_rot`). The `m < 0` branch of `V()`
  uses `sqrt(1+d)`, which is not the coefficient printed in the 1998 erratum.
  Both changes are explained in comments in the file.
- **Comment tidying only:** `FFfromSph.m`, `ReadSphModes_freqs.m` (H1 line and
  usage example) and `SphModes_demo.m` (a note that its data files are not
  included).
